name: Southwestern Economics Association 2027 Annual Meeting (at SSSA 2027)
edition: 106th Annual Meeting of the Southwestern Social Science Association
organizer: Southwestern Economics Association (affiliate of the Southwestern Social Science Association, SSSA)
deadline_note: Submission deadline December 15, 2026 (SSSA-wide; economics papers go to the Economics affiliate)
submission_requirements: Paper title and abstract via the SSSA PheedLoop proposal form (regular panel, poster and/or workshop session); for a full session, each author submits individually and the affiliate program chair is emailed to group them
registration_fee: SSSA early bird: USD 150 professional members / USD 300 professional non-members / USD 70 student members / USD 163 student non-members; +USD 55 (professionals) / +USD 25 (students) after March 24, 2027
